title: Layers panel
description: A layers panel for an editor, like Figma's, composing the @moderno-ui/{framework} SortableList, Toggle, Menu, Editable, Tooltip and Button primitives: one row per layer, top row front-most, with its thumbnail or kind icon, its name (cut short with the full name in a Tooltip), a visibility Toggle ("Hide Logo" / "Show Logo"), a lock Toggle ("Lock Logo" / "Unlock Logo") and a Menu with Duplicate, Rename and Delete; an empty state with Add layer. The list is a SortableList named "Layers": one Tab stop on the selected row, Up/Down/Home/End between rows, Tab through the row's toggles and menu, Space picks a row up and a drag reorders it. Each row's name button carries its state (aria-current, ", hidden, locked"); Enter or a click selects, a double click, F2 or Rename renames it inline with Editable (Enter saves, Escape cancels), Delete asks the app to delete it. Controlled only: it renders layers and selectedId as given and reports onSelect, onReorder, onChange, onDuplicate, onDelete and onAdd. Hidden rows are dimmed; the toggles show on row hover and stay while hidden or locked; responds to its container (@container) — from @sm the thumbnails grow and Add layer shows its label.
